system.description:
At the start of the scene you gain [Cancel (Dragon, Giant, Fairy): 20]. Your "Healing Light", "Healing Wind" and "Prayer of Recovery" are treated as having +1 SR (they may exceed their max SR). A headpiece created by infusing magic into the feather, a symbol of a free soul. It strengthens the bond between companions and enhances healing magic.

Flashy Plume [Core Material] (220G) + Feather Hat (50G) ×2 (100G) + Hachigane (80G) ×2 + [Magic Catalyst 10] (110G) ×3 + Crafting Cost (330G)
